verdicts.reason: A does rearrange the design into a left-to-right banner (headline left, body middle, Reserve a Case CTA right), but the Q logo and dark header band are gone. Its body copy and legal line are microscopic and unreadable, the 'Ships late June' line is jammed above the CTA, and the long headline is crammed into six tiny lines. B just shrinks the portrait original into a narrow centred column with huge empty bands on both sides, so every piece of text, the logo and the CTA are illegible specks. That is a squashed copy, not a resize, and is unusable.
